needs.proposedSignature: CardDef field castRestriction?: { timing?: 'combat' | 'main' | 'your-turn' | 'opponents-turn' | 'before-attackers' | 'after-blockers'; condition?: Condition } plus a `covers` kind naming it, so 'Cast ~ only during combat on your turn.' is a declaration rather than an ability.
needs.semantics: Savage Beating's first line. No CardDef field and no ability shape carries a cast-timing restriction; `activateOnlyIf` is the activated-ability analogue and does not apply to a spell. This family name already carries 3 cards in data/scripts/needs.json — Savage Beating is a fourth, though entwine blocks it first.
needs.clause: Cast ~ only during combat on your turn.

needs.proposedSignature: AltCostId 'entwine' plus a mode hook on the declaration: altCosts: [{ id: 'entwine', label: 'entwine {1}{R}', cost: { mana: <the INCREMENT> }, from: 'hand', chooseAllModes: true }] — and a ModeCostHook (the registry already has that hook shape) that, when the entwine cost was paid, resolves the spell's `choose-mode` with count = modes.length. A `covers` shape /^entwine[—-] ?(\{.+\})$/ over `altCosts` would then claim the printed line.
needs.semantics: CR 702.42a: 'Entwine [cost]' is a static ability of a modal spell that functions on the stack — 'You may choose all modes of this spell instead of just one as you cast it. If you do, you pay [cost] in addition to any other costs.' Entwine is an ADDITIONAL cost, not a replacement one, and what it buys is a change to the mode count, which nothing in the format can express today (`choose-mode.count` is a literal).
